reported_not_failed.length_rule: Owner ruling 2 Nov 2026 (scripts/lib/floor_rule.js): over a ceiling never fails (the installer trims); under a floor fails only below 75% of it.
reported_not_failed.link_cap_exempt_reason: The cap reaches every served route. Exempt: the homepage (umbrella-homepage-shape matches its six cards literally) and the eight senior-living guides (four intake links each is the owner's own rule). Before 2026-10-26 the cap reached only /insights/ and /medium-articles/ pages no routing contract governed, which was 206 of 1,068 graded pages, and 862 pages carried a portfolio host over a quarter of their outbound links - four copies of ONE intake URL per page, satisfying a count that asked for four links and got four of the same one. The count is replaced by a stricter served-page pin in velocity-canonical-anchor-links (exactly one followed, attributed outbound intake anchor, and every capped CTA must reach it in-page).
reported_not_failed.concentration_exempt_reason: The two dentistry safety-net guides are pinned by velocity-canonical-anchor-links to six DISTINCT metro anchors on dentistryguides.com - a reader in Houston needs the Houston one - so a quarter-of-outbound-links rule cannot apply to a page whose purpose is that directory. The per-URL clause still applies to them and still fails if one metro is linked twice.
